name: Omascreencast
author: Sam Ralial
description: Use a Chromecast TV as an arrangeable virtual second monitor, plus a monitor arranger for every connected display. Userspace only.

barWidget.description: Cast a virtual network monitor to a Chromecast TV and arrange every display.

schema.label: Virtual monitor resolution
schema.description: Hyprland headless outputs currently offer 1920x1080@60 (Spike A); other values fall back to it.

schema.label: Language
schema.description: Language for status text and notifications.

schema.label: Device nickname
schema.description: A friendly name for the TV, shown in the panel and notifications.

schema.label: Auto-reconnect
schema.description: Retry the cast after a network drop (up to three attempts).

schema.label: When the TV disconnects
schema.description: Keep the virtual monitor so the TV can reconnect, or remove it automatically when the receiver disappears.

schema.label: Codec
schema.description: auto prefers HEVC when the receiver advertises it, otherwise falls back to H.264. VP9 is software-only; AV1 is CLI-only/experimental on this hardware.
